Backgammon League

Backgammon League

Last updated: 28 October 2026

Backgammon League is a calm, standard backgammon app for Android and iPhone. For help with your account, purchases or privacy, contact panayiotiskpanaretos@gmail.com.

Contact

Email panayiotiskpanaretos@gmail.com and include your username and tag and the device you use. We aim to reply within a few working days. Never send your password, sign-in codes or payment card details.

Purchases and subscriptions

Missing gold or ad-free access: open the Shop and choose Restore / check purchases while signed in to the account you bought with.

Manage or cancel a subscription: on iPhone at https://apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions, on Android at https://play.google.com/store/account/subscriptions.

Refunds are handled by the store: Apple at https://reportaproblem.apple.com and Google Play at https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/2479637.
